# Contributing to Solstice

Solstice is independently maintained and is not affiliated with the Krita
project or KDE. This GitHub repository is the home of Solstice development.
Upstream Krita synchronization has been discontinued.

Open Solstice issues and pull requests at
[udtren/Solstice](https://github.com/udtren/Solstice). Target the default
branch, `krita-sol-gpu`. Do not send Solstice-specific requests to Krita's
GitLab instance or KDE's bug tracker.

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for repository policy and the development
document index. Preserve existing copyright and license notices.
